profile.name: PV位置器软件组件
profile.description: 非物理的软件组件，用于将一个或多个过程变量（PV）组织成统一的位置器接口。它提供设定值写入、读回监视、软限位检查、停止控制、运动状态与完成状态判断等能力，常用于实验自动化中把电机、执行器或一般位置型PV封装为可移动对象。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that organizes one or more process variables (PVs) into a unified positioner interface. It provides setpoint writes, readback monitoring, soft-limit checks, stop control, motion-state reporting, and move-completion logic, and is commonly used in experimental automation to represent motors, actuators, or general position-like PVs as movable objects.

registry.name: Pv Positioner
registry.description: Pv Positioner驱动，支持check value/move/stop/egu/put complete等9个操作。
